name: kp-c1-night
_comment: THE C1 EXAM (docs/development/app-master-c1-exam.md). Three UNSEEDED rung-0 ideation nights against the kp tenure: read, rank, propose, decline — no worktree, no fleet session, no gate run, no PR. The night's product is a proposal list and a decline log, and this scenario grades those instead of the branches nobody would merge. It is deliberately unseeded: a seeded night measures whether the holder can execute work it was handed, which is the ring that closed in 2026-08; the question here is whether it can pick the work at all. Runs against tenures/kp-owner.json — hire it once with `run.mjs --scenario kp-default --hire-only`, and supply the operator's ranked backlog with `--backlog <file>` (pre-scored {title, value} rows) or rankVsBacklog reads null and says so. The dialog block below is NOT posted on a tenure run; it records the mandate the tenure was hired under. `probation: false` declines the probation phase: that phase forces the review due NOW, and §5 is explicit that a P2 exit must not retire the tenure — it is the P3 soak's subject and starts accumulating from night 1.

dialog.context: We do not want another pair of hands. We want someone who reads the app every night and tells us which of the things we could build is actually worth building — and says out loud what they decided not to propose, and why.
dialog.title: App master for kp, ideation
